bounds.fetch_policy: incremental rows; retain bounded prefix, mark incomplete, never return truncated data as success

configuration: Host-supplied source_commit/configuration frozen before any query; offline validation receipt separately pins actual candidate commit and all source hashes.
failure_evidence: UTF8-invalid SQL is rejected before token/execute with lossless bounded ASCII-JSON query evidence and no invented UTF8 hash. Execute BaseException/cancellation retains original error type/message and unsuccessful/incomplete capture, then propagates. No signal/process guarantee.
failure_policy: One callback invocation causes at most one execute; capture failures and partial results, propagate original execution exceptions; no retries or implicit favorable/latest call selection.

known_upstream_semantic_gaps.disposition: Preserved upstream limitation; no verifier/scorer correction, normalization or scientific success claimed. Requires a separately reviewed verifier decision/amendment.
known_upstream_semantic_gaps.expected_scientific: A captured exact co-max member with unique_winner=false is valid even without secondary tie ordering.
known_upstream_semantic_gaps.observed: Pinned v1 may return contradicted/captured_result_mismatch for legitimate tied LIMIT1 without secondary sort.

prohibitions: no active wiring or provider API changes
no historical query replay or rescore
no activation, merge or automatic reviews
sql_backend_scope: One private memory-only agentic_analytics.delivery_work_items table; qualified/unqualified name compatibility. Readonly authorizer denies attachments/mutation/unrelated objects and unapproved functions; SQLite fixture semantics only.
trusted_boundary: Only claim is untrusted; arbitrary malicious Python host/caller or process compromise is outside scope. No serialized claimant envelope can register captures.
